propositions: The ownership-direction and field-consumption gates currently run in separate places (one in .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml only, one nowhere) and must be unified into the make lint target as the single portable source
Both gates must be wired into the Makefile lint target so CI inherits them through the existing make lint step, eliminating the standalone workflow step and preventing double-runs
The ee2a if-present guard in the workflow becomes unnecessary because a patchset's own Makefile version determines gate execution, providing inherent backwards compatibility
Workflow-parity tests must be updated to assert that both gate invocations exist in Makefile lint and that CI still runs make lint, so removing either fails the check
The test_ci_wires_the_gate assertion must be re-anchored from the workflow YAML to the Makefile lint target
The portable make lint path must execute both gates with no CI provider present, proving the trigger is operation-linked not CI-only
